definitions.gloss: cross jump (jump rope, crossing the arms)
definitions.explanation: A jump-rope technique in which the jumper crosses their arms in front of the body just before the rope passes underfoot, then uncrosses them on the next swing. A staple trick-jumping move in Japanese elementary school jump-rope routines.

examples.japanese: {交差|こうさ}{跳|と}びに⟦{挑戦|ちょうせん}する→挑戦する：21602_chousensuru⟧。
{交差|こうさ}{跳|と}びは⟦{腕|うで}→腕：01006_ude⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{交差|こうさ}→交差：00246_kousa⟧させて⟦{跳|と}ぶ→跳ぶ：19597_tobu⟧⟦{技|わざ}→技：02172_waza⟧だ。
examples.english: The cross jump is a technique where you jump while crossing your arms.

examples.japanese: ⟦{何回|なんかい}→何回：08497_nankai⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{練習|れんしゅう}して→練習する：22991_renshuusuru⟧、やっと{交差|こうさ}{跳|と}びを⟦{連続|れんぞく}→連続：03783_renzoku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{跳|と}べる→跳ぶ：19597_tobu⟧ようになった。
examples.english: After practicing many times, I was finally able to do the cross jump repeatedly without stopping.

notes:
{交差|こうさ}{跳|と}び is a trick jump in which the arms are crossed in front of the body right before the rope passes under the feet, then uncrossed for the next swing. It requires more coordination than the basic ⟦{前|まえ}{跳|と}び→前跳び：30927_maetobi⟧ and is often one of the first "tricks" children learn.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{前|まえ}{跳|と}び→前跳び：30927_maetobi⟧: forward jump
- ⟦{後|うし}ろ{跳|と}び→後ろ跳び：30928_ushirotobi⟧: backward jump
- ⟦{片足|かたあし}{跳|と}び→片足跳び：30930_kataashitobi⟧: single-leg jump

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {交差|こうさ}{跳|と}びをする: to do a cross jump
- {交差|こうさ}{跳|と}びが⟦{跳|と}べる→跳ぶ：19597_tobu⟧: to be able to do a cross jump
